title: Refs and browser APIs
summary: Reach the DOM element behind a JSX tag with useRef to focus a field, and keep a value between renders without re-rendering. You will compare a ref with state in the re-render flash, read the window size through a resize listener with cleanup, and add a keyboard shortcut that jumps to the form.
changeNote: Rewritten so each step opens with an explainer or a prediction, folds the background under Read more, and ends with a quiz.
